$description: Platform-neutral design tokens for the PBS VPPA Consent Modal (CTV / OTT 1920 scale). W3C Design Tokens Community Group format. This file is the single source of truth: every platform (HTML smart TV, tvOS, Android TV, Roku) maps these values to its own native styling primitives. See PORTING.md for the mapping tables. Values are authored at the OTT 1920 (1080p, 10-foot) scale that the Figma 'CTV' device uses.

white.$description: Primary / White. Primary button fill; title, body, and secondary-button text.

pbsBlue.$description: Primary / PBS Blue. Primary (Agree) button label color.

modal.$description: Modal panel fill. rgb(10,20,90) at 60% alpha, layered over the blurred backdrop.

secondaryFill.$description: Secondary (Decline) button fill. White at ~10% alpha.

onSurface.$description: Title and body copy on the modal surface.

disclaimer.$description: 'A selection is required to continue.' helper text (variant only).

ring.$description: TV focus ring. White reads on both the white primary button and the translucent secondary button because the ring sits offset on the dark modal surface. PROPOSED — not specified in the provided Figma node.

body.$description: OTT 1920 / Body Copy 3 Regular 28. Legal consent copy.

buttonLabel.$description: OTT 1920 / H4 Bold 32. Button label. NORMALIZED: Figma authored Agree at 32 and Decline at 30 as two separate instances; the component uses one shared label style (32) so both buttons match. Confirm with design.

disclaimer.$description: OTT 1920 / Body Copy 3 Regular 28. 'Selection required' helper text.

pill.$description: Button corner radius. Half the button height = fully rounded ends (Figma used 79/72 over an ~80px height, i.e. a full pill).

sectionGap.$description: Vertical gap between the text block and the button row (and between title and body).

buttonGap.$description: Horizontal gap between the two buttons.

buttonX.$description: Button horizontal padding (min). NORMALIZED from Figma's 71/65 to one value; buttons flex to share the row width equally.

contentWidth.$description: Max width of the content column (title + body + buttons).

buttonRowWidth.$description: Width of the two-button row; each button flexes to 50%.

buttonHeight.$description: Button height. NORMALIZED: Figma showed 80 (Agree) / 74 (Decline); the component uses one height.

backdrop.$description: Backdrop blur radius applied behind the modal when Blur=Yes. Set Blur=No (0) on platforms without backdrop blur (notably Roku).

scale.$description: Scale multiplier applied to a focused button. PROPOSED TV focus spec.

ringOffset.$description: Gap between button edge and focus ring. PROPOSED.
